ITEM 1 | Three flattened, golden-beige pieces with pale tan and slightly darker browned edges, soft-looking surface with faint speckles of orange-red bits and small dark green flecks; left-most piece about 6 cm long and 3 cm wide, folded/rolled with a dark green-black edge visible at its underside, middle piece about 5 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, right piece about 5 cm long and 3 cm wide with a dark charred edge; pieces lie side by side in a loose cluster covering roughly 15% of the white square plate, slightly moist sheen, no visible sauce | 60
ITEM 2 | Small scattered crumbs and specks of orange-tan and brown material on the plate rim and beside the food, each under 0.5 cm, sitting on the white plate surface and on the table next to it | 2
